newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian population nears one billion.
newsitem.headline: Indian population nears one billion.

text.p: India's population will number more than a billion by the turn of the century, according to a projection from government census experts reported by the Press Trust of India on Saturday.

The estimate would be confirmed by the next census in March 2001 which is expected to tally more than a billion people, compared to 846 million in 1991 and a current estimate of 930 million, PTI said.
